title: Non-indentical BG values for identical settings on watch and phone
symptom: The user reports that after switching from a phone to a smartwatch (both using the same Dexcom G5 transmitter and identical settings), the BG values on the smartwatch differ significantly from those on the phone.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. A commenter suggests that readings should not depend on hardware, but the issue remains unresolved.
fix: A commenter suggests a procedure for switching master devices: set the old phone as follower and uncheck 'Be master for followers', remove the G5 transmitter from Bluetooth devices, then on the new device select G5 under hardware data source and check 'Be master for followers'. Also, ensure settings for G5 are tested on both devices.
settings_changed: Be master for followers → unchecked on old phone
Be master for followers → checked on new phone
evidence_quote: To do the switch between phones you have to setup phone 1 as the follower (xdrip+ Sync Follower) and uncheck option " Be master for followers", additional remove you G5 transmitter from Bluetooth devices connected to the phone as it can cause problems during phone 2 connections attempts to G5 . On phone 2 select G5 under hardware data source and check the option " Be master for followers".
